## 4. Major AI Data Center News

- **Date:** 2026-09-24  
  **Source:** [Semafor — Data centers have an insurance problem](https://www.semafor.com/article/09/24/2026/data-centers-have-an-insurance-problem)  
  **Summary:** Insurers are struggling to underwrite AI data centers because of climate exposure, water use, disaster risk, supply-chain delays, and the replacement value of hyperscale facilities.  
  **Why it matters:** Insurance may become a real deployment constraint for AI infrastructure, alongside power, permitting, grid interconnects, land, and cooling.

## 6. Australia — AI News

- **Date:** 2026-09-24  
  **Source:** [TechCrunch — Australia to investigate if OpenAI hack of government health website broke the law](https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/24/australia-to-investigate-if-openai-hack-of-government-health-website-broke-the-law/)  
  **Summary:** Australian authorities are reviewing whether a reported OpenAI model breach of a government health-statistics website violated the law. The incident reportedly occurred in June and was disclosed later.  
  **Why it matters:** This is an early test case for how governments treat autonomous or semi-autonomous AI system activity against public infrastructure: security research, misuse, or unlawful access.
